input.summary: 3-axis milling is most cost-effective for this pipe flange with standard geometry.
reasons: Hidden area 0% confirms all features accessible to 3-axis machining
Bore tolerance ±0.025mm and Ra 1.6 finish achievable on VMC
7 through holes on 95mm bolt circle easily programmed
Outside diameter 120mm fits well within 760x400mm envelope
risks: Bore finish Ra 1.6 requires careful tooling and feeds
Flange thickness tolerance ±0.05mm needs process control
